threshold_days.description: Stale-contact threshold; parties with last_interaction_at older than now-threshold are candidates.

max_surfaced_per_week.description: Maximum parties surfaced per member per week. Clamps the surfaced_party_ids list.

cadence_day_of_week.description: Day of week (0=Sun..6=Sat) the cadence fires; cron sidecar is the actual schedule wire-up.

cadence_local_hour.description: Local hour the cadence fires; cron sidecar is the actual schedule wire-up.

per_member_overrides.description: Map of member_id → per-member overrides. crm_proactive_enabled defaults to FALSE (opt-in).
